data.exact_reserve_text: Stable experience in attritional and catastrophe reserves across all other classes of business

prior_year_events.impact_description: Favourable movement in 2016 & prior reserves referenced as contributing to run-off & RITC costs allocation

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 were GBP 128.664m. The company's gross prioryear development for years 2017 and earlier was effectively flat (net change nil on a gross basis). Management reports stable attritional and catastrophe reserves across most classes, though there was negative specific large loss experience in political risk, D&O and energy classes which affected results at a gross/net level; these did not produce a material gross prioryear reserve strengthening in the 2019 statement of financial position.
raw_causal_phrases: Negative specific large loss experience arising from new losses on the political risk, D&O and energy classes
Stable experience in attritional and catastrophe reserves across all other classes of business

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, prior year column). Prior-year development computed from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative claims) where the older underwriting years (2015-2017) show no change between the last development diagonal and the current estimate; hence prior-year development = 0.0m (gross). The report contains net (after reinsurance) reserve movements and RITC/risk premium allocations referenced in narrative, but no explicit gross prior-year movement quantified in text. Confidence for the triangle calculation is high but not absolute because narrative references net movements and allocations (risk premium) that affect net results.
